title: Kinks as Goals: Accelerating Commissions and the Performance of Sales Teams
eligible_reason: Not a difference-in-differences design. The paper studies bunching of daily team sales at commission kink points: regressions of bin indicators (binsales) on indicators for bins at/below/above the attainable threshold with bin x store x day-of-week and bin x holiday FE (Tables 3-4), and daily sales on distance-to-threshold bins (Table 5). No binary treatment switching on at unit-specific dates.
design_notes: Daily sales of 103 retail store teams in 2016 (kinks_2016sales.dta). GenerateMain.do reshapes to store-day-bin level; Table3.do/Table4.do: reghdfe binsales bin1below5..bin1above5 if pool1==1, absorb(binstoredow binholiday) vce(cluster storegroup). Appendix: placebo thresholds, leave-one-out, team-size splits. Full-text hit for de Chaisemartin and Cengiz et al. citations is unrelated to the estimation.
data_files: Data/ folder is empty; kinks_main.dta, kinks_2016sales.dta, kinks_appendixC/D.dta referenced but not shipped (company data under confidentiality; contact Lizi Yu)
screener_notes: Screened from package only (README docx, Kinks_Master.do, Codes/*.do, Outputs/*.log).
